description: List a project's HTTP route table: method, path, mounted `fullPath` (API prefix included), handler, policies, middlewares, `public` (auth: false), `auth` when customized, and where each route is declared (`filePath`/`offset`). Covers the project's explicit routes, the auto-CRUD routes synthesized from createCoreRouter, and the routes local and installed plugins declare (`origin`), read from node_modules without booting Strapi. Admin-panel routes are left out unless `admin: true`. Filter with `method`, `path` (a pattern, a part of it, or a concrete URL such as `/api/articles/12`) and `handler`. With `pipeline: true` (needs a filter, at most 20 routes), each route also gets what a request goes through, in Strapi's order — the `config/middlewares` stack (once, in `globalMiddlewares`), auth, policies, route middlewares, handler — each step with a status: `ok`, `not-found-by-strapi` (it exists under another name Strapi won't try: Strapi throws at startup), `unknown`, `unverified`, `unread` or `inline`. Use it to explain a 401/403, or a startup error about a policy or middleware.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

handler.description: Only routes whose handler (qualified, e.g. `api::article.article.find`) contains this.

method.description: Only routes of this HTTP method (e.g. `GET`).

path.description: Only routes whose path matches: the pattern (`/api/articles/:id`), a part of it, or a concrete URL it serves (`/api/articles/12`).

pipeline.description: Add each route's pipeline (needs method, path or handler; at most 20 routes).

plugins.description: Include routes declared by local and installed plugins (default true).

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

name: list_routes
title: List HTTP routes
